verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ delivery note WZ-260921-478 dated 21.09.2026 from Karton Nowak (Poznań) to the Soony Distribution Center in Hamburg, against PO 4500318712. It covers one line: CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6, 11.500 PCS (read as 11,500) in 11 packages, gross weight 198 kg. It is signed 'Schulz P.' in the received-by field. There are no crossed-out values, corrections or receiving stamps.
red_flags: The printed gross weight of 198 kg looks low for 11,500 hardcover 96-page art books in 11 packages (about 17 g per book). This is recorded as written and not corrected, but the buyer may want to check it.
No receiving date stamp, and no received quantity or discrepancy note. The only receipt evidence is the handwritten name 'Schulz P.'.
The product description is cut off in the printed line: 'Art Book Grand Heist 6 (96 p, hard'.
Return of the EUR pallets is requested.
observations: The item description is truncated at 'hard' with no closing parenthesis.
Quantity '11.500' uses the Polish thousands separator, so it is read as 11500.
The carrier field reads 'PO 64931', possibly a vehicle plate or carrier code; its meaning is not stated.
The handwritten 'Schulz P.' in blue ink sits above the 'Odebrał' signature line and is legible.
The lower two-thirds of the page is blank. There are no stamps and no prices on the document.
